title: Coordinador(a) Jr. de E-commerce — Amazon & Mercado Libre
description:
About the job

Coordinador(a) Jr. de E-commerce — Amazon & Mercado Libre




📍 Zapopan / Guadalajara, Jalisco 




¿Te gustaría ver en tiempo real cómo tus decisiones impactan ventas reales? Operamos varias marcas propias dentro de Amazon y Mercado Libre, y buscamos sumar a alguien que quiera aprender el negocio desde adentro — no solo ejecutar tareas, sino entender por qué las cosas funcionan (o no) dentro de un marketplace.




Aquí las ideas se escuchan de verdad, y tu trabajo tiene impacto directo desde el primer día.




¿Qué vas a hacer?

Te vas a involucrar en catálogo, campañas, inventarios y análisis de resultados de productos que la gente compra todos los días. También vas a participar en pensar qué estrategias probar y qué productos lanzar para hacer crecer las cuentas.




¿Para quién es esto?

Para alguien que estudia o estudió Comercio y Negocios Digitales, Mercadotecnia, Administración o carreras afines. Lo que más valoramos es el interés genuino en el e-commerce — no que sea "cualquier trabajo". Si además ya tienes algo de conocimiento básico o intermedio en e-commerce o marketplaces, suma bastante. Buscamos a alguien con ganas de resolver problemas y aprender rápido.




Lo que puedes esperar:

Formación práctica desde el primer día y participación en proyectos reales. Quien entra con actitud, en pocos meses ya está manejando responsabilidades con autonomía real — y si el fit es bueno de ambos lados, buscamos que ese crecimiento se traduzca en algo más permanente dentro del equipo.




¿Te interesa? Envíanos tu CV y cuéntanos qué te llama la atención del e-commerce. También puedes compartir esta vacante con alguien que consideres que puede encajar.




#Ecommerce #Amazon #MercadoLibre #Empleo #Guadalajara

We're a US-based agency that grows painting and concrete coating contractors — about 100 clients across the US and Canada, through web, SEO, ads, and CRM. You'll own organic performance across multiple contractor accounts — technical SEO, on-page, local SEO, and the reporting that proves it worked.

What you'll do:

Technical SEO — schema, redirects, canonicals, indexing, internal linking, site architecture
On-page & content — search intent, keyword targeting, metadata, content refreshes, QA
Local SEO — Google Business Profile, citation building/cleanup, local ranking strategy across metros
Analysis & reporting — rankings, traffic, and indexing in GSC and Ahrefs; competitor gaps; what moved and why

2–4+ years hands-on SEO (technical, on-page, and local) with results you can point to

About the job

Affiliate & Influencer Marketing Specialist

Remote | Full-time | 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (flexible, we care about results, not clocks) | Fluent English required




Salary Range: $900 to $1,500 USD per month plus performance bonuses, based on experience.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a fast-growing, women-owned DTC eyewear brand known for innovative, problem-solving sunglasses and bold product design. Our slogan, “sunglasses with a solution,” reflects our focus on function, style, and constant improvement. We’ve built a global customer base and a highly engaged social community of over 250,000 followers, driven by founder-led storytelling, product innovation, and performance-driven content.




We operate as a lean, high-performance team where speed, ownership, and results are the standard. We move fast, test constantly, and prioritize revenue impact over surface-level activity.




The Role

We're looking for a strategic, highly organized, and relationship-driven Affiliate & Influencer Marketing Specialist to help grow one of TopFoxx's most important revenue channels.




Success in this role isn't determined by how many influencers you recruit, it's measured by your ability to build strong relationships, activate creators, generate consistent content, and drive profitable revenue.




While experience in influencer or affiliate marketing is valuable, we're equally interested in candidates with exceptional communication, persuasion, and marketing skills who are eager to learn. If you're naturally proactive, enjoy building relationships, think strategically, and know how to motivate people, we want to hear from you.




This role requires someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, takes ownership, builds themselves to be the expert in their field and enjoys improving systems while delivering measurable business results.




Core Responsibilities




1) Affiliate Recruitment & Relationship Management

Build and scale a large affiliate creator network across TikTok, Instagram, LTK, and other relevant platforms.
Recruit, onboard, and develop creators with the goal of building a network of 5,000+ affiliates.
Build meaningful relationships with creators through personalized outreach and ongoing communication.
Develop long-term partnerships that encourage consistent posting and repeat collaboration.
Keep creators engaged by providing timely support, product recommendations, campaign updates, and performance feedback.
Re-engage inactive affiliates and maintain a healthy, active creator pipeline.




2) Affiliate Growth & Performance

Build and grow a high-performing affiliate network focused on consistent revenue generation rather than vanity metrics.
Monitor affiliate activity, posting frequency, conversions, and overall performance.
Identify top-performing creators and develop strategies to scale their success.
Analyze underperforming partnerships and make recommendations to improve results or discontinue collaborations.
Continuously optimize commission structures, gifting strategies, incentives, and creator engagement to maximize ROI.




3) Campaign & Program Management

Coordinate gifting campaigns, product launches, seasonal promotions, and creator initiatives.
Support TikTok Live scheduling and collaboration opportunities with affiliates.
Ensure creators receive accurate information, products, tracking, and campaign materials.
Maintain organized workflows and ensure campaigns are executed on time.




4) Data, Reporting & Optimization

Maintain accurate CRM records, affiliate databases, and outreach tracking.
Monitor key performance indicators including revenue, GMV, conversion rate, posting activity, ROI, and affiliate retention.
Prepare clear reports identifying trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
Use data to recommend new strategies, improve efficiency, and support profitable program growth.




5) Systems & Continuous Improvement

Develop SOPs, templates, and scalable processes that improve efficiency.
Stay informed on creator trends, platform updates, and emerging marketing opportunities.
Test new outreach strategies, partnership ideas, and growth initiatives.
Support additional marketing and growth projects as business needs evolve.




Requirements & Experience

Required

Excellent written and spoken English.
Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills.
Strong persuasion and negotiation abilities.
Highly organized with excellent attention to detail.
Strategic marketing mindset with a focus on measurable business results.
Strong analytical skills and ability to interpret performance data.
Ability to manage multiple projects and conversations simultaneously.
Self-motivated with the ability to work independently.
Comfortable learning new platforms, tools, and systems quickly.
Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and initiative.

Preferred

Experience in Influencer Marketing, Affiliate Marketing, Partnership Marketing, or related marketing roles.
Experience working with creators, influencers, or online communities.
Familiarity with eCommerce platforms.
Experience building workflows, SOPs, or scalable marketing processes.
Understanding of digital marketing, consumer behavior, and conversion optimization.




Who You Are

Entrepreneurial: You spot opportunities others miss and act on them, solving problems without waiting for direction
Growth-Obsessed: You want to be the best in your field, not just good at the job, so you teach yourself relentlessly and treat becoming the go-to expert as a personal standard
Competitive Greatness: You're driven to be the best and you bring your A-game when it matters most, especially under pressure
Analytical: You think in ROI, margins, and performance, not vanity metrics
Persuasive: You understand creator psychology and know how to motivate consistent posting and sales
Creative Differentiator: You know the market is oversaturated, so you find creative ways to cut through: your communication style, the genuine care you bring to your creators and the product, and how thoughtfully you present and place it
Execution-Focused: You can manage high volume without losing structure or quality
Professional: You're the face of TopFoxx to every creator you touch, so you communicate with polish, follow through on what you promise, and represent the brand with care
Ownership Mentality: You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks




Benefits

Competitive salary based on experience with performance bonuses
Performance-based bonuses tied to results
Fully remote work
PTO + paid holidays
Free TopFoxx products
Clear path to a leadership role




While experience in Influencer Marketing or Affiliate Marketing is valuable, it is not the only path to success in this role. We are looking for someone with exceptional communication skills, strong marketing judgment, and the ability to build relationships and persuade people. The right person may come from influencer marketing, partnerships, sales, community management, brand marketing, or another field where communication and strategic thinking drive results.




This is a high-ownership, performance-driven role. You will be responsible for building a real revenue engine, not managing surface-level influencer activity. If you are motivated by growth, ownership, and measurable impact and know how to build profitable affiliate systems, we want to meet you!




Don't see the perfect fit? If you believe you'd be a great addition to TopFoxx but this role isn't the best match, we'd still love to hear from you. Please email your resume and a brief introduction to recruiting@topfoxx.com and let us know which role(s) you're interested in. We're always excited to connect with exceptional talent.

I’m helping System Blue Solutions find a top candidate to join their team flexible for the role of Lead Generation Specialist - Commission Based.




You will drive business growth by independently managing high-impact lead generation cycles.

Unpaid




Location:

Remote (anywhere)




Mission of System Blue Solutions:

"We know firsthand how overwhelming it can be to juggle strategic responsibilities while handling tasks that could be delegated to the right support professional. That's why we developed a streamlined process for sourcing, vetting, training, and matching exceptional offshore Virtual Assistants and Executive Assistants to the specific needs of each client."




What makes you a strong candidate:

You are proficient in Sales outreach, Sales, Prospecting, Network, Lead qualification.
English - Conversational




Responsibilities and more:

We're looking for a Lead Generation Specialist who thrives on autonomy, hustle, and getting paid for outcomes — not attendance.




This is a 100% commission-based, recurring-pay position. There is no hourly rate, no salary, and no guaranteed income. You earn when you generate results. If that excites you rather than scares you, keep reading.




What You'll Do:

- Proactively source, qualify, and generate new sales leads through your own channels, network, and prospecting methods.

- Optionally hand off qualified leads to our sales team for closing, or run the full cycle yourself (prospect → pitch → close) if you have the skill set.

- Maintain accurate, real-time tracking of every lead you generate so commissions are correctly attributed.

- Operate independently, using your own tools, systems, and outreach strategy.

- Sign and honor a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) to protect company and client information.




Compensation Structure (Recurring Commission)

This role is commission-only — there is no hourly, salary, or retainer pay of any kind.

- You source the lead, our sales rep closes the deal 5% recurring commission

- You source the lead AND close the deal yourself 10% recurring commission

Commissions are recurring, paid monthly, for as long as the client stays active.




Tools & Equipment

- You must supply your own laptop/computer, internet connection, phone/dialer, and any CRM, prospecting, or outreach tools you use.

- The company does not provide equipment, software licenses, or tool stipends for this role.




This role is built for self-starters who are willing to bet on themselves.

You'll thrive here if you:

- Are genuinely energized by uncapped, performance-based earning potential — not just tolerating it.

- Have (or can build) your own lead sources, network, or prospecting system from day one.

- Are disciplined enough to manage your own schedule, pipeline, and outreach without supervision.

- Treat this like running your own micro-business, not "a job."

- Are comfortable with income variability in exchange for unlimited upside.




To be direct: this is not the role for someone looking for stability, a predictable paycheck, or a traditional 9-to-5 job.




Your potential leader(s):

Vaxy Valmyr - Salesforce Specialist | NPSP | Apsona | IModules at Philadelphia College of Osteopathic Medicine

Sales outreach, Sales, Prospecting, Network, Lead qualification, Lead generation, Cold outreach, CRM

About the job

Join Schneider Electric as a Creative Design and Development Specialist and bring bold ideas to life. You'll craft compelling visual and written content that strengthens our brand and engages audiences across every channel—working with talented teams who value creativity and innovation.

Digital Marketing Specialist, Paid Media leads the planning, execution, optimization, and operational management of paid media campaigns across search, social, programmatic, and other digital advertising channels. Supporting both the US Public Sector (gov’t & education) and Global Private Sector businesses, this role drives brand awareness, demand generation, and business growth through effective media investments.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills, project management, and commercial acumen to deliver measurable business results. This role includes managing campaigns directly, working with agencies and media partners and leveraging AI-powered tools to improve marketing performance and team efficiency.

Whay will you do?


Digital Advertising Activation: Plan, activate and optimize digital advertising campaigns on corporate-owned platforms to ensure optimal performance. Strategize highly targeted segment campaigns to accelerate lead pipelines and sales opportunities. 
Social Media Campaign Activation: Execute paid social media campaigns across platforms, performing ongoing A/B tests and ensuring accurate targeting, deployment, and alignment with marketing objectives. 
Paid Search: Develop and optimize paid search strategies to drive qualified traffic, business results, and brand visibility. Work with agency partner for continuous optimization and performance. 
3rd-Party Paid Ad Buying: Lead end-to-end planning, negotiation, placement, and execution of paid media investments across third-party advertising channels and manage agency and publisher relationships. 
Campaign Analytics, Optimization & Reporting: Apply a test-and-learn approach while monitoring campaign performance to generate actionable insights and optimize media investments to improve effectiveness and ROI. Lead quarterly performance presentations and best practice sharing with global marketing teams.

Focus on business outcomes while managing media investments responsibly.

Adapt quickly, solve problems proactively, and continuously improve performance.

High-impact work—your creativity shapes how a global brand connects with audiences

Ready to bring your creative talent to a brand that's making a difference? Apply today!

Operating in one of Latin America's fastest-growing fintech markets, the organization combines advanced digital platforms, data-driven decision-making, and robust risk management to strengthen its market position while maintaining strict regulatory compliance.

As part of its continued expansion, the company is seeking an experienced executive to lead its marketing organization in Mexico, driving brand growth, customer acquisition, and commercial performance. Reporting directly to the Board of Directors, this executive role is responsible for aligning local marketing strategies with global business objectives while overseeing integrated campaigns, marketing operations, agency partnerships, and organizational leadership.

description:
About the job

Google SEO & AI Specialist

Remote — LATAM | Independent Contractor | Mid-Level

Compensation: Competitive, based on experience




Rose Harper Law is scaling its digital presence across four office markets in New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania and search is changing faster than most firms can keep up with. We need someone who lives at the intersection of traditional SEO and the new world of AI-driven search (think AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity) to make sure our firm shows up, wins trust, and converts when injured people go looking for help.




About Rose Harper Law




Rose Harper Law, LLC is a bilingual (English/Spanish) personal injury plaintiff firm licensed in New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania, with offices in Parsippany NJ, Hawthorne NY, Allentown PA, and Hazleton PA. We're a fast-growing, faith-driven, community-rooted practice, and our marketing engine including a distributed LATAM content and social team is a core part of how we reach and serve the communities we work in.




About the Role




Twelve months from now, this role will have measurably grown organic visibility across all our markets and made sure Rose Harper Law is showing up accurately and favorably in AI-generated search answers, not just traditional blue links. You'll work closely with our Digital Content Coordinator and LATAM content/social team, applying both classic SEO discipline and emerging AI/answer-engine optimization (AEO/GEO) practice to a fast-moving, multi-market content operation.




What You'll Do




• Own on-page and technical SEO across roseharperlaw.com and its 13-market city landing pages — audits, on-page fixes, internal linking, schema, and site health.

• Apply AEO/GEO strategies to improve how the firm is represented in AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other AI-powered search surfaces.

• Conduct keyword research and competitive analysis to identify content gaps and new ranking opportunities across our practice areas and markets.

• Manage and optimize Google Business Profile pages across all four office locations — listings, posts, Q&A, reviews, and local search performance.

• Build and execute a backlink strategy: identify link opportunities, run outreach, and track domain authority and referring-domain growth over time.

• Develop and lead outreach for publication and media relationships — guest posts, local press, and legal directories that build authority and referral traffic.

• Coordinate SEO priorities with our social media team so content, keywords, and publishing calendars are aligned across channels rather than working in silos.

• Partner with our content team to brief, edit, and structure blog posts, YouTube companion content, and landing pages for both traditional and AI search.

• Track rankings, organic traffic, and Domain Rating growth, and report on what's working in plain language leadership can act on.

• Stay ahead of algorithm and AI-search developments and translate them into practical changes to our content and technical setup.




What We're Looking For




Required:




• 3+ years of hands-on SEO experience, agency or in-house.

• Experience applying AEO/GEO strategies or otherwise optimizing content for AI-powered search results.

• Strong working knowledge of on-page, technical, and local SEO fundamentals.

• Experience with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics.

• Track record running backlink/outreach campaigns and building relationships with publications, directories, or media contacts.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills; Spanish fluency is a strong plus given our bilingual client base.

• Comfortable working independently, managing your own workload, and meeting deadlines across a distributed team.

• A portfolio or case studies showing measurable organic growth or AI-search visibility gains (required to apply — see How to Apply below).




Preferred (nice to have):




• Experience in legal, professional services, or another regulated/compliance-sensitive industry.

• Familiarity with WordPress or a similar CMS.




Compensation




Competitive, based on experience. This is an independent contractor position open to candidates residing in Latin America.




How to Apply

Send the following to info@roseharperlaw.com and mcevallos@roseharperlaw.com:

• Your resume.

• A portfolio or case study demonstrating measurable SEO or AI-search results you've driven (required).

• A short written analysis of roseharperlaw.com's current SEO/AI-search visibility, along with a proposed 3-month action plan for how you'd approach the role — we want to see how you think, not a polished agency pitch.

Buscamos a quien conciba la venta como el oficio de tejer confianza, anticipar oportunidades y transformar la aspiración de cada cliente en proyectos tangibles de arquitectura, interiorismo y construcción.




Alguien con recorrido al frente de equipos y procesos comerciales, que combine iniciativa con mirada de largo plazo para abrir nuevas líneas de negocio. Un perfil estratégico, con fino trato humano y la solidez para conducir conversaciones y acuerdos de gran envergadura frente a clientes que distinguen la calidad.




Se desenvuelve con soltura entre clientes que aprecian el diseño, la exclusividad y el cuidado por el detalle, y sabe interpretar lo que un interlocutor exigente espera incluso antes de que lo formule. Domina la venta consultiva de proyectos de alto valor dentro de la arquitectura residencial y el interiorismo. Definirás el rumbo comercial del estudio y liderarás su crecimiento. Identificarás oportunidades, cultivarás alianzas con brokers, constructoras, inmobiliarias y aliados estratégicos, y harás crecer una red de referidos coherente con el lugar que ocupa AVEs.

En cada encuentro, cuidarás que la experiencia esté a la altura del estudio.




Guiarás al equipo comercial marcando prioridades, dando seguimiento cercano y asegurando que ninguna oportunidad se enfríe por falta de método o ritmo.




Serás también quien mantenga el pulso del área: CRM al día, reportes claros y un trabajo hombro a hombro con Comunicación, Administración y Diseño para llevar cada proyecto desde el primer contacto hasta su contratación.

About the job

EMPLOYMENT OFFER: RISK ANALYST




📍 WORK DETAILS

Location: Avenida Paseo de la Reforma (In-person)
Schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM
Expected Starting Date: ASAP




🏢 ABOUT NETEVIA




Netevia is a leading provider of payment processing services, supporting over 30,000 businesses across various industries. Our platform enables businesses to accept multiple forms of payment, including digital wallets, credit/debit cards, and ACH transactions. We are seeking to expand our team and are looking for motivated professionals to join us in delivering exceptional services.




📊 POSITION OVERVIEW: Risk Analyst




We are looking for a dedicated Risk Analyst to join our team. This role offers a strong opportunity for professional development, mentorship from industry experts, and hands-on experience within a dynamic environment.

As a Risk Analyst, you will be responsible for the accurate processing and review of merchant applications, ensuring compliance with credit policies and card brand regulations. The position also involves handling data integrity reports, internal controls, and participating in ad hoc projects related to merchant risk and onboarding operations.




🧩 KEY RESPONSABILITIES




Perform daily data entry and management of merchant applications in the boarding database and across internal systems.
Conduct thorough quality control reviews of applications submitted by sales partners, ISOs, and internal teams.
Execute retroactive and ad hoc MATCH inquiries to ensure compliance with risk standards.
Prepare and deliver regular internal MIS reports (daily and weekly).
Respond promptly to monthly data integrity reports from MasterCard, Visa, and Discover.
Collect and validate data for prospective merchants, following company policies and card brand rules.
Contribute to ad hoc operational and compliance projects as assigned by the Risk Manager.




🧠 REQUIRED SKILLS, ABILITIES, KNOWLEDGE




Associate’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
Strong attention to detail and excellent task prioritization skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel; experience with Access and Visio is a plus.
Solid written and verbal communication skills.
Prior experience in the merchant acquiring industry is a plus.
Previous role as a bank representative is a strong asset.
English fluency required; Spanish proficiency is a plus.




🚀 WHY JOIN NETEVIA?




At Netevia, you’ll join a forward-thinking team committed to innovation, integrity, and client satisfaction. We invest in our people and believe in fostering a culture of growth, collaboration, and professional development.

We look forward to welcoming you to our growing team!

title: Lead Acquisition Specialist
description:
About the job

About AutoVanish

AutoVanish is an automotive broker operating in California, USA. We help people sell their car: the customer gets an instant online offer, and we manage the deal through our network of buyers — quote, negotiation, paperwork, and pickup logistics — until the seller gets paid. We're growing and looking for talent to join our Tijuana team.

Sobre AutoVanish

AutoVanish es un broker automotriz que opera en California, EE.UU. Ayudamos a las personas a vender su auto: el cliente recibe una oferta instantánea en línea y nosotros gestionamos la operación con nuestra red de compradores — cotización, negociación, papeleo y logística de la recogida — hasta que el vendedor recibe su pago. Estamos creciendo y buscamos talento para nuestro equipo en Tijuana.




¿Qué harás?

Nada de llamadas en frío. Trabajarás con clientes que ya nos contactaron pidiendo una cotización por su auto. Tu trabajo es cerrar el trato:

• Dar seguimiento por teléfono a leads que solicitaron una oferta en nuestro sitio web

• Explicar al cliente cómo funciona el proceso y resolver sus dudas (oferta, papeleo, título, entrega)

• Negociar y cerrar la operación entre el vendedor y el comprador

• Gestionar cada operación de principio a fin: coordinar papeleo, tiempos y logística de entrega con las partes involucradas

• Registrar tu actividad y dar seguimiento a tu cartera de leads en el sistema




Lo que buscamos:

• Experiencia comprobable en ventas (telefónicas, call center, automotriz o similar)

• Inglés conversacional avanzado — tus clientes están en Estados Unidos (indispensable)

• Actitud de cierre: te motivan las comisiones y los resultados

• Excelente comunicación, seguimiento y organización

• Disponibilidad para trabajar presencial en Tijuana

No necesitas licencia de conducir ni visa — todo el trabajo es desde nuestra oficina.




Ofrecemos:

• $15,000 MXN mensuales de base garantizada + comisiones sin tope por cada operación cerrada

• Horario fijo de lunes a viernes, 7:00 am a 3:00 pm — tus tardes son tuyas

• Sábados y domingos opcionales con pago extra, si tienes disponibilidad

• Leads calificados que ya quieren vender — no buscas clientes, los cierras

• Capacitación pagada desde el primer día

• Oportunidad de crecer con una empresa en expansión en EE.UU.




¿Te interesa? Postúlate con tu CV actualizado. Buscamos gente que quiera ganar bien y crecer rápido.What you'll do

No cold calling. You'll work with customers who already reached out asking for a quote on their car. Your job is to close the deal:

• Follow up by phone with leads who requested an offer on our website

• Walk customers through the process and answer their questions (offer, paperwork, title, delivery)

• Negotiate and close the deal between seller and buyer

• Manage each deal end to end: coordinate paperwork, timelines, and delivery logistics with all parties

• Track your pipeline and log activity in our system




What we're looking for

• Proven sales experience (phone sales, call center, automotive, or similar)

• Advanced conversational English — your customers are in the U.S. (required)

• A closer's mindset: commissions and results motivate you

• Strong communication, follow-up, and organization skills

• Available to work on-site in Tijuana

No driver's license or visa required — all work is done from our office.




What we offer

• $15,000 MXN guaranteed monthly base + uncapped commissions on every closed deal

• Fixed schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:00 am – 3:00 pm — your afternoons are yours

• Optional weekend shifts with extra pay, if you're available

• Qualified leads who already want to sell — you close, you don't hunt

• Paid training from day one

• Room to grow with a company expanding across the U.S.




Interested? Apply with your updated resume. We're looking for people who want to earn well and grow fast.Responsibilities

title: SDR (Inbound & Outbound)
description:
About the job

Acerca de Nosotros:

TheGurúCompany: Somos un Venture Builder con 23 años de experiencia, especializados en desarrollar, invertir y co-crear empresas B2B de nicho. Utilizamos tecnologías avanzadas como Inteligencia Artificial y Visión por Computadora para impulsar el crecimiento de nuestros proyectos y de nuestros clientes a nivel global.

Acerca de este Rol

Como SDR (Inbound & Outbound) en TheGurúCompany, tu misión será generar y gestionar oportunidades de negocio de alto valor, combinando estrategias de prospección outbound con la atención y calificación efectiva de leads inbound.

Este rol es clave para asegurar un flujo constante y saludable de pipeline. Serás responsable tanto de iniciar conversaciones estratégicas con prospectos como de capitalizar el interés generado por marketing, asegurando velocidad, calidad y conversión en cada interacción.

Buscamos a alguien que no solo ejecute, sino que piense en cómo hacer más eficiente todo el proceso: desde el primer contacto hasta la generación de oportunidades calificadas, utilizando datos, creatividad y tecnología (incluida IA).

Responsabilidades:

Gestión de Leads Inbound

 Dar seguimiento oportuno a leads entrantes provenientes de campañas, formularios, eventos y otros canales.

 Calificar prospectos con base en fit, necesidad y timing.

 Contactar rápidamente para maximizar tasas de conversión.

 Agendar reuniones de calidad para el equipo de ventas.

Prospección Outbound

 Generar nuevas oportunidades mediante outreach multicanal (email, LinkedIn, llamadas, networking).

 Identificar cuentas objetivo y construir listas de prospectos de alto valor.

 Diseñar y ejecutar secuencias de contacto personalizadas.

Investigación y Personalización

 Investigar empresas, industrias y perfiles clave para adaptar mensajes relevantes.

 Detectar pains, oportunidades y triggers comerciales.

 Utilizar herramientas de data e IA para enriquecer la prospección.

Optimización y Performance

 Medir desempeño de campañas y esfuerzos (open rate, reply rate, conversión a reunión).

 Optimizar continuamente mensajes, canales y enfoques.

 Probar nuevas herramientas, automatizaciones y estrategias.

Colaboración con Marketing y Ventas

 Trabajar de la mano con marketing para mejorar la calidad de los leads inbound.

 Alinear esfuerzos con ventas para asegurar reuniones calificadas.

 Retroalimentar con insights del mercado y comportamiento de prospectos.

Gestión de CRM y Pipeline

 Registrar y actualizar interacciones en el CRM.

 Mantener orden y visibilidad del pipeline generado.

 Asegurar handoff claro y documentado al equipo de ventas.

Acerca de Ti:

Formación y Experiencia:

 Mínimo 2 años de experiencia como SDR o en ventas B2B.

 Experiencia tanto en manejo de leads inbound como en prospección outbound.

 Deseable experiencia en tecnología, SaaS o soluciones digitales.

Conocimientos Técnicos:

 Manejo de CRM (Odoo, Salesforce, HubSpot o similares).

 Experiencia con herramientas de prospección (Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.).

 Familiaridad con herramientas de automatización (Outreach, Lemlist, Instantly).

 Conocimiento o interés en herramientas de IA (Clay, Claude u otras).

 Nivel de inglés intermedio (deseable).

Habilidades Clave:

Velocidad y sentido de urgencia: respondes rápido y priorizas correctamente leads inbound.

 Mentalidad data-driven: tomas decisiones basadas en métricas y resultados.

 Comunicación efectiva: redactas y comunicas con claridad y persuasión.

 Autonomía: gestionas tu pipeline con responsabilidad y enfoque en resultados.

 Curiosidad y mejora continua: optimizas constantemente tus procesos.

 Organización: manejas múltiples leads y campañas sin perder calidad.

Stack (ideal, no excluyente):

CRM: Odoo

 Prospección: Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay, Lusha

 Automatización: Outreach, Lemlist, Instantly

 IA & Data: Clay, Claude y herramientas similares

KPIs del Rol:

Reuniones agendadas (SQLs) y calificadas

 Tiempo de respuesta a leads inbound

 Tasa de conversión (lead → reunión)

 Tasa de respuesta outbound

 Pipeline generado

 Volumen de actividades (emails, llamadas, LinkedIn)

Lo que ofrecemos:

Trabajo 100% remoto

 Cultura enfocada en resultados, autonomía y aprendizaje constante

 Exposición a herramientas y estrategias de inbound y outbound moderno + IA

 Oportunidad de crecimiento dentro del equipo comercial

We're driven by an AI-first engineering culture and a bold vision: to become the number one partner for retailers' eCommerce growth. To get there, we're looking for an exceptional Product Engineer who turns ideas into shipped products: owning features end to end, from concept to proven business value, and using AI at every step to build faster and better.




This is a role for intrapreneurial builders: people who spot what needs to be done and act on it, thrive when priorities shift, and create structure where none exists yet, rather than waiting.




Who We Are




Zubale is a technology company that empowers retailers to win in eCommerce. We serve a wide range of clients — from supermarkets, specialty stores, and pharmacies to department stores and fashion brands — across Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Costa Rica, Peru, Colombia and now Argentina. How do we do it? Through two key products:

Flexifleet: A freelance marketplace to perform picking, packing, and delivery tasks for retailers and aggregators.
Consumer Connect: AI-powered conversational commerce via WhatsApp to drive sales and enhance customer experience.




We are passionate about helping brands, aggregators, and retailers optimize their eCommerce operations, reduce costs, and increase profitability. Backed by over $70 million in venture capital, we have maintained steady growth over the past six years and completed more than 100 million orders through our platform. Today, we serve over 100 clients and connect thousands of freelancers within our network. And this is just the beginning.




We are building a profitable and scalable ecosystem, with the vision of becoming the number one partner for retailers’ eCommerce growth.




Who you are

A Builder of Scalable Systems: You build and deliver scalable software, with autonomy. 
An Impact-Driven Product Creator: You solve business problems through high-impact products.

What you will do

Design, prototype, build, deploy, iterate, and scale high-impact products, from idea to proven business value.




Build & Ship Product

Drive Product Decisions

Create Leverage Through Systems

Build AI-first

Iterate & Improve

Influence & Drive Adoption

The skills and experience you bring

Fluency English + Spanish
Strong product sense and modern product discovery practices
Hands-on experience building with agentic AI systems.

description:
About the job

Misión del puesto: Diseñar, ejecutar y evolucionar la operación de atención al cliente mediante la automatización inteligente de procesos, el desarrollo de equipos y la aplicación práctica de IA, transformando las funciones de Onboarding y Customer Support en una operación escalable, consultiva y orientada a resultados que maximice la retención, expansión y satisfacción de los clientes.




🛠️ Actividades principales

Transformación de Operaciones con IA

• Mapear y analizar los procesos de Onboarding y Customer Support para identificar oportunidades de automatización y escalabilidad.

• Diseñar, implementar y optimizar soluciones de IA que automaticen tareas repetitivas, consultas frecuentes, actualizaciones de estatus, procesos de onboarding e interacciones internas.

• Liderar la evolución del modelo operativo, definiendo qué actividades deben automatizarse y cuáles requieren intervención humana de alto valor.

• Medir y monitorear el impacto de las automatizaciones mediante indicadores como deflection rate, tiempo ahorrado, eficiencia operativa y redistribución de capacidad del equipo.

• Participar activamente en la construcción, configuración y mejora de automatizaciones, herramientas y flujos impulsados por IA.




Onboarding y Activación

• Liderar la estrategia de incorporación de nuevos clientes, asegurando una reducción continua del tiempo para generar valor (Time to Value).

• Diseñar experiencias de onboarding escalables, personalizadas y asistidas por IA para los distintos productos de Leadsales.

• Definir, monitorear y optimizar métricas de activación que impacten positivamente la adopción y retención de clientes.

• Garantizar una experiencia de implementación eficiente para soluciones como WhatsApp Business API, QR e integraciones de la plataforma.




Customer Support

• Liderar al equipo de Customer Support, asegurando el cumplimiento de SLA, estándares de calidad, CSAT y tiempos de resolución.

• Transformar el modelo de soporte tradicional hacia un enfoque consultivo y orientado a la resolución de problemas de negocio.

• Desarrollar las capacidades del equipo para identificar oportunidades de mejora, brindar recomendaciones estratégicas y acompañar a los clientes en la optimización de sus procesos comerciales.

• Convertir los hallazgos y necesidades de los clientes en retroalimentación estructurada para los equipos de Producto e Ingeniería.




Expansión

• Diseñar y consolidar la función de Customer Success mediante modelos de segmentación, health scores, playbooks y estrategias de seguimiento proactivo.

• Liderar iniciativas enfocadas en reducir churn, incrementar Net Revenue Retention (NRR) y fortalecer la adopción de la plataforma.

• Impulsar conversaciones de valor con clientes que permitan identificar oportunidades de expansión, upselling y crecimiento de cuentas.

• Asegurar que el equipo genere relaciones consultivas que contribuyan al éxito y crecimiento de los clientes.




Liderazgo

• Formar parte del equipo directivo y liderar las áreas de Revenue bajo la metodología EOS/Traction mediante Scorecards y reuniones L10.

• Gestionar el presupuesto, herramientas y recursos del área bajo una mentalidad de eficiencia, escalabilidad y apalancamiento tecnológico.

• Priorizar soluciones de automatización antes de considerar incrementos de headcount o nuevas contrataciones.

• Diseñar la evolución organizacional del área, definiendo nuevos roles, competencias, planes de desarrollo y rutas de carrera conforme las actividades transiten de operativas a consultivas.

• Liderar desde la ejecución, colaborando activamente con el equipo en implementaciones, automatizaciones, configuración de herramientas y contacto directo con clientes.




📚 Experiencia

• +6 años de experiencia en área de Operaciones, Soporte en una empresas SaaS B2B, idealmente atendiendo Pymes con alto volumen de clientes

• +3 años de experiencia transformando procesos, capacitando equipos y gestionando métricas clave del área




Nice to Have

- Experiencia en comercio conversacional, WhatsApp Business Platform o productos de mensajería.

- Experiencia construyendo AI APIs, automatizando sin código o creando agentes por tu cuenta.

- Experiencia con EOS/Traction o un marco similar.




🌟 Soft Skills

• Builder mindset

• Liderazgo transformacional

• Pensamiento estratégico

• Resolución de problemas complejos

• Orientación a resultados

• Adaptabilidad y aprendizaje continuo

title: Freelance AI Instructional Designer/ LED
description:
About the job

AI Learning Experience Designer

As an AI Learning Experience Designer (ID/LED), you will be responsible for designing and

contextualizing cutting-edge, instructor-led AI training programs for both technical and

non-technical audiences. You will collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs),

instructional designers, and product managers to create engaging, outcome-driven learning

experiences that help learners grasp, apply, and innovate with AI technologies.




Terms and Details:

● This is a flexible, contractor position on a per-project basis

● We would expect someone to provide at least 30 hours per week when on a project

● This role will be 100% remote




Key Responsibilities:

Discovery

● Work with leading LED or project managers to define key skills, competencies, learning

objectives and pathways within the discipline.

● Support sales teams or product teams in identifying client and learner needs and goals

and proposing learning solutions.




Design & Development

● Follow our client's design and development standards, best practices, and processes for

core and customized curriculum, materials, and assets.

● Design and develop AI-focused learning experiences that cater to learners at varying

levels of expertise and technical proficiency.

● Create instructor-led training materials (slides, hands-on labs, case studies, assessments)

aligned with best practices in AI education.

● Partner with AI subject matter experts (SMEs) to design practical, interactive exercises,

such as coding challenges, AI model-building workshops, and ethical AI decision-making

scenarios.

● Curate and contextualize existing AI content to align with emerging industry trends,

ensuring materials are always relevant and up to date.

● Design structured learning pathways for AI skills development, from foundational AI

literacy to advanced deep learning applications.

● Work with vendors, contractors and freelancers in content, assessment, and support

material production.




Delivery

● Develop instructor enablement materials to support live classroom training delivery (e.g.,

facilitator guides, learner workbooks, real-world case studies).

● Provide guidance to instructors on best practices for AI education, including effective

strategies for live coding demonstrations, interactive discussions, and problem-solving

activities.

● Work closely with instructors, learning facilitators, and client teams to tailor learning

programs for diverse audiences, including enterprise clients, startups, and government

organizations.

● Collect, synthesize and analyze data on learning impact for continuous improvement,

refinement, and content updating.

● Where applicable, work with translation vendors in the localization of content.

Productization

● Work with product management and learning teams to standardize patterns and

components for base curricular products.

● Work with product management and learning teams to build out the library of product

components, exemplars, and documentation.




Requirements:

● Has created content for an instructor-led program that focuses on AI concepts.

● Background in a client-facing role, either supporting or managing, is highly desirable

● Experience collaborating with AI subject matter experts to translate complex concepts into

structured, engaging learning experiences.

● 8+ years of instructional design or learning experience design with a focus on AI, data

science, or emerging technologies.

● Knowledge of instructional design methodologies, including Bloom’s Taxonomy, ADDIE,

and experiential learning models.

● Strong knowledge of AI concepts such as machine learning, large language models

(LLMs), neural networks, and ethical AI considerations.

● Thrives working in fast-paced, dynamic environments.

● Familiarity with Google Suite, and LMS content management and authoring tools.

● Willingness to flex your schedule to join meetings in different time zones, particularly in the

United States and Europe, Middle East, and Asia.




Nice to Have:

● Technical proficiency in AI and coding (Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar AI

frameworks). Including knowledge of GitHub.

● Familiarity with Virtual Machines (VM)

● Hands-on experience developing AI training labs, coding exercises, or real-world AI case

studies.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
About the job

Sales Development Representative (SDR) 

Remote 




About the Company

Hirably is a fast-growing company in the SaaS and embedded payments space, serving the buy-here-pay-here (BHPH) auto industry. 

We help dealers run and collect on their own loan books, and we're profitable and growing quickly. We're hiring an SDR to help us break further into the largest dealers in the market. 




Compensation 

$25,000 MXN net per month, plus uncapped monthly variable tied to the MRR generated from deals you assist in closing. 

Fully remote. 




About the Role

You'll be Hirably's next Sales Development Representative, focused on our largest dealer prospects: BHPH operators running 500+ active loans. You'll report directly to our VP of Revenue, who owns Sales and Marketing and runs weekly 1:1s with this role. You'll have direct access to executive coaching from day one. 




These are family-owned businesses with lean teams, big loan books, and a different relationship with cash flow and collections than a typical SMB. Breaking into this segment takes disciplined, high-volume outbound work, and that's what this role is built around. 




You'll partner directly with our senior account executives, generate qualified demos, hand off opportunities cleanly, and shorten the time from cold outreach to closed-won revenue. You're joining a growing sales team, inheriting a sales engine that already converts well and a CRM operation we're actively tightening in real time. You'll be one of the people putting that discipline into the daily motion, booking qualified meetings, and helping AEs close. 




This is an earlier-stage role for us, with real room to grow. The opportunity to move into a closing seat or hybrid role that blends prospecting with running smaller deals is real, and we'll invest in developing people who earn it. 




Responsibilities 

● Run a high volume of outbound cadences across phone, email, and LinkedIn against a defined portfolio of BHPH dealers running 500+ active loans. 

● Qualify against our ICP before booking demos. A demo that shouldn't have been booked costs the team more than the time it took to book it. 

● Book qualified demos with confirmed dates and pre-demo discovery logged in HubSpot. Maintain a strong show rate through multi-channel confirmation (reminder call/text, day-of confirmation, cell number capture at scheduling). 

● Log everything: activity, calls, demo recordings, and loss reasons. If it isn't in HubSpot, we have no way to know it happened. 

● Support post-demo nurture and multi-threading on live deals, and contribute to competitive intel and loss reason capture. 




Qualifications 

● You can point to real evidence of cold outreach and resilience, whether that's directly carrying an outbound sales quota or something like canvassing, fundraising, telemarketing, or door-to-door sales. 

● You genuinely enjoy making dials and you're phone-first by default. ● You're disciplined in a CRM (HubSpot preferred). 

● You're coachable, and comfortable working through deals one at a time in a weekly 1:1 with our VP of Revenue. 

● You track your own numbers and own them, good weeks and bad ones. The scoreboard doesn't scare you. 

● You write tight and get real energy from picking up the phone. 

● Based in or willing to work Eastern or Central US hours. 

● English Level Required: C1/C2 Preferred Skills 

● BHPH, subprime auto, or auto retail experience. This is a real advantage, but direct industry experience isn't required — genuine curiosity about how dealers run their loan books is. 

● Experience selling to family-owned or owner-operated SMBs. 

● Comfort with longer sales cycles (60-120 days) and multi-threading across 2-4 stakeholders

description:
About the job

Nuestro equipo de Customer Experience

Nuestra misión es ayudar y acompañar a emprendedores y grandes marcas de Latinoamérica a vender online, ofreciendo un servicio de calidad fuera de serie, convirtiéndonos en un diferencial crítico para la compañía. Además de brindar un excelente nivel de soporte, el papel de este equipo ante el cliente es aún mayor: son guardianes de su experiencia, no solo cuando hablan con ellos sino en cada interacción que tienen con otros equipos de Tiendanube. Por eso, además de ayudar y orientar a nuestros merchants y partners a resolver dudas y problemas con sus negocios dentro de la plataforma,también participan de proyectos y colaboran con diversos teams, llevando la voz del cliente al resto de la compañía con el objetivo de mejorar los procesos de atención, la experiencia del usuario y nuestro producto.

Ayudar a personas emprendedoras y negocios a responder sus dudas, resolver sus problemas y dar consejos sobre la plataforma de Tiendanube o del negocio en general, asesorándolos por email, redes sociales, chat o teléfono, siempre dando lo mejor en cada interacción;
Brindar soporte a todos nuestros clientes y partners, siguiendo los parámetros más altos de calidad, brindando respuestas claras, completas, personalizadas y empáticas;
Ser parte de un equipo autónomo que debe organizarse para cumplir sus objetivos de calidad y tiempos de respuesta, impactando de manera directa en la experiencia de los usuarios y los objetivos del negocio.


Lo que buscamos 


Formación o Estudios en Marketing, Comunicación, Administración, Programación, Ventas o carreras afines.

Martes a viernes de 11 a 20 hs y sábados de 9 a 18 hs. 

Es un plus


Contar con conocimientos en configuración de RRSS (Instagram Shopping, Facebook Shopping)
Tener conocimientos en diseño, edición de imágenes y HTML/CSS/JS.
Experiencia o conocimientos previos trabajando dentro de empresas del sector de logística, distribución, correo o plataformas de e-commerce.
Cualquier otro conocimiento que te enorgullezca y que pueda ayudar a otros negocios.


Nuestro proceso

Queremos que tengas la mejor experiencia posible a lo largo de nuestro proceso de selección. Después de que te postules, el equipo de Talent Acquisition revisará tu perfil con atención y, sin importar el resultado, recibirás una respuesta.

Las etapas y los plazos pueden variar según cada vacante, pero no te preocupes — vamos a mantenernos en contacto contigo durante todo el proceso.

Lo que te proponemos


Cobertura médica privada;
Clases de portugués 100% cubiertas;
Reembolso de tu factura de Internet con conexión de 50 megas;
Descuentos en cursos de Coderhouse;
Licencia familiar extendida a 21 días corridos para personas no gestantes o adoptantes;

Somos #remotefirst, priorizamos el trabajo remoto dentro del país de contratación siempre que el rol lo permita;
Es un ambiente de reto constante, propósito y protagonismo — aquí la innovación nace de pensar en grande y tener actitud gigante.


Anuncio de Privacidad

Tiendanube se compromete a proteger la privacidad y garantizar la seguridad de las personas indicadas para las vacantes que ofrecemos.

Para analizar tu solicitud, tendremos acceso a parte de tu información que será revisada antes de continuar. Utilizaremos estos datos para realizar los procesos de reclutamiento y selección. Además, cuidamos muy en serio a nuestras personas y solo compartimos información realmente necesaria. En última instancia, solo los mantendremos en nuestro sistema durante el tiempo que realmente lo necesitemos.

Para obtener más información sobre cómo manejamos los datos, incluidos tus derechos según la ley, simplemente acceda a nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.

description:
About the job

Who We Are

Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com.

The Role

As an Inside Customer Success Rep you represent the face of the company and will primarily work with Large, Medium sized customers. You will build and maintain strong customer relationships with our customers while resolving customer issues. The Inside Customer Success Rep must be able to plan and execute daily and weekly, required activities. You must also be adept at multi-tasking, working within a team and other departments that drive successful business outcomes for the customer and for Solera-Omnitracs. In this role you must be comfortable using and/or learning new or other communication and automation tools. A great candidate does well with conflict resolution and can thrive in a fast-paced, change – heavy environment. The ideal candidate is goal and detail oriented, dedicated, hard-working, and maintains a positive attitude.

 Be an advocate for the customer, be the voice of the customer
 Hold and lead recurrent customer business meetings
 Interact with other departments to resolve customer related matters
 Continued Development- Learn Industry News, ELD Mandates, Issues Related to Transportation and Updates to Omnitracs Products and Services.
 Ensure team goals, team KPIs, and deadlines are met
 Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned


What You’ll Bring


 Experience working in a Customer Success environment
 Familiar with DOT/FMCSA/CSA Regulations a plus
 Results-oriented with strong problem- solving skills
 Exceptional customer facing customer skills, the ability to quickly understand customer needs
 Team-oriented and able to build and maintain strong inter-team and inter-departmental relationships
 Excellent verbal and written English communication skills

 Excellent consultative skills

 Ability to work independently with minimal direction

Blue Gems Management is one of Florida's fastest-growing vacation rental management companies. Our Core Values

Ownership. We take initiative and own outcomes end to end.
High Standards. Five-star is the baseline. We sweat the details others skip.

Accountability & Integrity. We follow through, document clearly, and do it right.



The Role

The Guest Experience Agent delivers consistent, five-star guest communication and support across every stage of the guest journey. You protect revenue, safeguard owner trust, and keep day-to-day operations running smoothly by proactively managing guest needs, coordinating with internal teams, and resolving issues quickly and professionally. Average guest response time consistently within target

Strong OTA account health — no preventable penalties or violations

Highly organized and detail-oriented.
Comfortable working in fast-paced, high-volume environments.
A strong written and verbal communicator.

➡️ Comunicación: Capacidad de explicar retos complejos y soluciones de manera clara.




EL ROL:

Buscamos persona que pueda tanto tener visión de una estrategia, como ejecutarla y con capacidad operativa para construir, optimizar y escalar campañas desde cero en Meta y Google Ads.




Estrategia y Ejecución Autónoma

➡️ Creación y optimización diaria de campañas en Meta y Google Ads (Search, PMax, YouTube).

➡️ Gestión granular de presupuesto para maximizar ROAS y reducir CPA/CAC sostenidamente.

➡️ Implementación de segmentaciones avanzadas, A/B testing y ajustes. Eres responsable de diseñar la estrategia y llevarla a la práctica.




Análisis de Datos (Data Ownership)

➡️ Auditoría y diagnóstico de tracking. Es indispensable saber implementar eventos de conversión usando Google Tag Manager, Pixel y Conversions API, en sinergia con nuestro equipo de Analytics.

➡️ Análisis del embudo completo (CTR → CVR → MQL → SQL → Venta → LTV) para detectar fricciones y aplicar soluciones.

➡️ Monitoreo constante de la calidad de la data para asegurar una atribución correcta.




Estrategia de Conversión

➡️ Direct Response Advertising Copywriting

➡️ Análisis de rendimiento para generar insights data-driven

title: Trade Marketing Manager
description:
About the job

TRADE MARKETING MANAGER




About the Role

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Trade Marketing Manager to design and lead the commercial and channel strategy for SKINTIFIC México. This role owns the trade investment agenda, translating brand strategy into channel-specific plans that accelerate sell-in and sell-out, strengthen category performance, and maximise return on every peso invested at the point of sale.

Working at the intersection of Sales, Marketing and Finance, you will define pricing and promotional architecture, build Joint Business Plans with our key retail partners, and turn shopper, category and market data into commercial decisions that drive profitable growth across Modern Trade, Pharma, Specialty Beauty and eCommerce.




Are You Ready to Grow With SKINTIFIC?




Key Responsibilities

Channel & Commercial Strategy

• Define and lead the national Trade Marketing strategy across Modern Trade, Pharma, Specialty Beauty, Wholesale and eCommerce channels.

• Translate brand and marketing plans into channel-specific and customer-specific commercial plans, tailored to each retailer’s shopper profile.

• Build the Route to Market strategy and define the portfolio, assortment and pack-price architecture per channel.

• Lead the commercial calendar, aligning product launches, seasonal campaigns and promotional cycles with Sales and Marketing.




Trade Investment & Profitability

• Own and govern the A&P and trade investment budget, ensuring disciplined allocation and measurable return.

• Design the promotional strategy and pricing architecture, protecting margin while driving volume and market share.

• Measure and optimise promotion ROI, reallocating investment towards the highest-performing mechanics, customers and categories.

• Partner with Finance on P&L management, trade spend accruals, profitability analysis and budget forecasting.




Customer & Joint Business Planning

• Co-develop Joint Business Plans (JBP) with key retail partners, defining shared growth targets, investment commitments and activation calendars.

• Support Key Account Managers in customer negotiations with data-driven proposals, category stories and business cases.

• Build strong relationships with retail partners, distributors and internal stakeholders across the organisation.




Category Management & Shopper Insights

• Lead category management initiatives: planogram recommendations, assortment optimization, shelf strategy and space allocation.

• Translate shopper, consumer and market insights into actionable commercial recommendations and in-store activation concepts.

• Monitor competitive activity, pricing dynamics and category trends to identify growth opportunities and mitigate risks.




Execution & Activation

• Define in-store execution standards, visibility guidelines and POP material strategy, partnering with the Retail team on deployment.

• Lead the development of trade materials, displays and merchandising assets, managing agencies and external suppliers.

• Ensure perfect store execution through clear guidelines, tracking mechanisms and post-activation evaluation.




Reporting & Business Analysis

• Prepare regular sales reports, account reviews and business performance updates for local and regional leadership.

• Track KPIs including sell-in and sell-out growth, market share, distribution, inventory turnover, trade spend efficiency and promotion ROI.

• Build dashboards and analytical models to support decision-making, using Nielsen, Kantar and internal sales data.

• Provide data-driven recommendations to improve account performance, channel profitability and operational efficiency.




Requirements

Experience & Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Finance or a related field. Postgraduate studies are a plus.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in Trade Marketing, Customer Marketing or Category Management within beauty, skincare, cosmetics, pharma or FMCG.

• Solid experience in Modern Trade and Pharma channels; experience with Specialty Beauty retailers and eCommerce is highly valued.

• Background in multinational beauty, personal care, pharma or FMCG companies strongly preferred.




Technical Skills

• Advanced Excel is mandatory 

• Advanced English is mandatory

• Strong command of market data platforms: Nielsen, Kantar, IQVIA or equivalent.

• Solid financial acumen: P&L understanding, margin analysis, pricing structures and trade spend management.




Competencies

• Analytical mindset with the ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable commercial recommendations.

• Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership across Sales, Marketing, Finance and Supply Chain.

• Strong negotiation, communication and presentation skills at senior management level.

• Highly organised, with strong execution capability and comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

• Entrepreneurial and hands-on: able to build processes from scratch in a newly established market operation.




Why Join SKINTIFIC

• Join one of the fastest-growing beauty brands in the region, at the very start of its Mexican operation.

• High-impact role with genuine ownership of the commercial agenda and direct exposure to regional leadership.

• Build the trade marketing function from the ground up, shaping processes, standards and ways of working.

• Dynamic, collaborative and multicultural working environment.

• Opportunity to grow together with a rapidly expanding international business.




Business Unit Summary

SKINTIFIC is a science-driven skincare brand dedicated to delivering high-performance products for diverse skin concerns. Backed by data and trusted by millions of consumers across Asia, we are expanding rapidly into new markets — and Mexico is one of our key growth priorities.

About the job

Working with Us

Challenging. Meaningful. Life-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high-achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.

Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more: careers.bms.com/working-with-us.

Brand Lead, Oncology – GI (Opdivo & Opdivo SC Launch)

Bristol Myers Squibb es un empleador que brinda igualdad de oportunidades. Las personas que apliquen para cualquier vacante, y que estén calificadas para la misma recibirán consideración para el empleo sin distinción de raza, color, religión, sexo, orientación sexual, identidad de género, nacionalidad, edad, discapacidad, condición de veterano protegido, embarazo, ciudadanía, estado civil, expresión de género, información genética, afiliación política o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

Job Summary

The Brand Lead, Oncology – Gastrointestinal (GI) is a strategic and executional leader responsible for driving the commercialization of Opdivo (nivolumab) in GI indications and leading the launch of Opdivo SC (subcutaneous formulation) in the market. This individual will develop and implement integrated brand strategies that reflect a deep understanding of the public and private healthcare market dynamics, including specialty and high-complexity treatment settings. As part of the BMS Oncology Commercial team, this role plays a pivotal part in ensuring speed to patients, cross-functional alignment, and business excellence in a highly competitive therapeutic landscape.

Job Description

The Brand Lead reports to the Associate Director, Oncology, and serves as the brand strategy owner for the GI oncology portfolio and responsible for the launch of Opdivo Subcutaneous. This individual will be the orchestrator of a cross-functional brand team, translating scientific and clinical evidence into compelling commercial strategies that resonate with oncologists, multidisciplinary teams, and healthcare institutions across both public (institutional/government) and private market segments.

We are seeking a results-driven, patient-centered professional, passionate about oncology and experienced in specialty/high-complexity product management, who brings strong strategic acumen, executional discipline, and proven launch excellence capabilities aligned with the BMS Commercialization Model.

Key Responsibilities

Brand Strategy & Commercialization


Lead the development and execution of the annual brand plan for Opdivo GI indications and Opdivo SC, including situation analysis, strategic imperatives, tactical mix, and investment allocation.
Define and manage the brand positioning, messaging architecture, and value proposition for Opdivo in GI oncology across all customer segments.
Drive Opdivo SC launch readiness and execution, coordinating all pre-launch and launch activities across commercial, medical, market access, regulatory, and supply functions.
Develop and monitor brand performance KPIs, adjusting strategies and tactics based on market insights and competitive intelligence.
Digital Innovation & Omnichannel Excellence: Proven ability to lead integrated omnichannel campaigns that seamlessly connect field force, digital, and medical channels to deliver a consistent and impactful brand experience; hands-on experience applying Artificial Intelligence and advanced analytics tools to anticipate market trends, improve customer segmentation, and drive data-informed commercial decisions in specialty oncology.


Market Insights & Customer Understanding


Lead market research and analytics initiatives to generate deep understanding of the GI oncology landscape, unmet needs, patient journey, and stakeholder dynamics.
Map and analyze public market (IMSS, ISSSTE, IMSS Bienestar) dynamics, formulary processes, institutional protocols, and purchasing cycles.
Monitor private market dynamics including managed care, oncology networks, key oncology centers, and high-specialty hospitals.
Integrate insights from field-based teams, medical affairs, and market access to continuously evolve brand strategies.


Cross-Functional Leadership


Lead and energize the Brand Team (TAS/Sales, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Patient Advocacy, Finance) ensuring cohesive strategy and aligned execution.
Partner with Medical Affairs to ensure the scientific platform supports commercial objectives within compliance guidelines.
Collaborate with Market Access to develop value-based tools and evidence strategies for institutional access (public tenders, CBNSS inclusion).
Work closely with the global brand team to align local strategy with global brand direction.


Launch Excellence – Opdivo SC


Own and drive the Opdivo SC launch plan, from pre-launch readiness assessment to first patient use and post-launch tracking.
Lead development of launch promotional tools, training materials, and go-to-market plans for Opdivo SC across public and private channels.
Orchestrate cross-functional launch readiness reviews (LRR) and milestone tracking.

Operational Excellence & Compliance

Manage brand budget with accountability, ensuring resource allocation maximizes ROI and strategic priorities.
Contribute to business planning cycles (P1, P2, P3, Budget, LRP) with accurate forecasting and strategic narrative.

Education


Bachelor's degree required in Life Sciences, Business Administration, or related field
MBA or advanced degree strongly preferred


Experience


Minimum 7–10 years of commercial experience in the pharmaceutical/biotech industry

Proven track record of successful product launch execution (pre-launch through steady state)
Demonstrated expertise in public market (institutional) strategy and access dynamics
Experience managing brands in private market including HMOs, oncology networks, and specialty clinics

Competency

Description

🎯 Strategic Thinking

Ability to translate market insights into differentiated, long-term brand strategies

🚀 Launch Excellence

Proven experience leading multi-channel launches in complex therapeutic areas

Technical Skills

BMS Values

This role exemplifies the BMS values of Passion, Innovation, Urgency, Accountability, Inclusion, and Integrity — all essential to delivering transformative therapies to patients with serious diseases.

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

Being part of the Driver Operations team will give you the unique opportunity to help drive growth in one of the fastest growing companies ever. Be prepared for a hectic, fast paced and challenging environment. Never a dull moment!

The Vehicle Solutions team is key in ensuring DiDi’s continued expansion through SSL by focusing on bringing additional supply into the platform through the development of partnerships, strategies around acquisition, conversion and retention. The preferred candidate for this role should possess robust strategic commercial expertise, analytical capabilities, exceptional time-management and organizational skills, and be prepared to set a leading example.

Whether creating innovative collaboration methods with external stakeholders, pinpointing enhancement opportunities, evaluating implementation choices, you will consistently pursue scalable solutions, directly fueling DiDi's growth in Mexico and LATAM!

In this role, you'll be...


Stay informed about automotive industry trends, market dynamics, and competitor activities related to partnership opportunities
Driving collaboration, fostering innovation, and increasing the organization's outreach through strategic alliances with prospects for innovative collaboration with external stakeholders
Continuously identify improvements and expansion within existing partnerships
Provide insights into essential metrics for fleet partnerships and develop strategic approaches, showcasing expertise in converting data into valuable insights in the commercial area by using analytical tools proficiently.
Balance attention to detail with swift execution: We need to do things quickly, and we need to do them well. Balancing those can be challenging, but this should be our strength.
Create a fun, inclusive, and safe work culture: Demonstrating dedication and commitment to the team's goals and objectives, investing time and effort to achieve shared success, and contributing to a positive team culture



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Experience in commercial roles, showcasing skills in recognizing opportunities, negotiating agreements, and driving revenue growth
All backgrounds are welcome if you see yourself suitable in a strong analytical environment 
Demonstrated experience in collaborating with commercial teams through data-driven decision-making, exhibiting strong judgment in uncertain scenarios. 
Engaged team player with a positive outlook, proficient communicator within a diverse team
Proven to be self-motivated, self-directed, and eager to take ownership of tasks
Fluency in both English and Spanish
SQL advanced



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.
